As a Team Leader Logistics at Zara in the center of Almere, you are responsible for coordinating and supporting the warehouse team during the morning shifts. You ensure deliveries are processed efficiently and that the store always has the right stock available on time.

You lead the team during unloading and sorting deliveries, divide tasks among colleagues, and monitor the progress of daily warehouse activities. You motivate the team, help solve operational issues, and ensure the warehouse remains organized and safe at all times.

Besides managing daily operations, you work closely with store management and contribute ideas to improve logistics processes. You are hands-on, proactive, and enjoy working in a dynamic retail environment where teamwork is essential.

This role is perfect for someone with leadership qualities who enjoys responsibility and wants to develop further within an international retail organization.

- Minimum MBO working and thinking level
- Leadership experience, preferably in logistics, retail, or e-commerce
- Experience managing teams
- Knowledge of Warehouse Management Systems such as JDA
- Delivers accurate, high-quality work while seeking continuous improvement
- Communicates respectfully and inspires team engagement
- Automation experience is highly desirable
- Able to work independently and motivate colleagues
- Physically fit and comfortable with active work
- Speaks Dutch or English
- Flexible and solution-oriented mindset

This job is ideal if you are looking for flexible work alongside your studies or another job. You will be part of a friendly team while taking responsibility for your own tasks.

Your workday starts with unpacking deliveries. You sort clothing and accessories before storing everything neatly in the correct place in the warehouse. You ensure the store always has enough stock available. Together with your colleagues, you keep the warehouse clean and organised. You'll stay active throughout your shift and support your team whenever needed.

This job is perfect if you're looking for a flexible part-time role. No experience is required, as you'll quickly learn everything on the job. Do you want to work in an inspiring environment right in the city centre? Apply now and make a difference! ✨

- At least VMBO working and thinking level

- Experience is not required, but an advantage

- You can work independently and in a team

- You are physically fit and proactive

- You speak Dutch or English
